Alex (Sales): Zenith POC: SSE stream drops mid-event, client sees partial JSON and parse error. Need fix before demo.
Priya (SE): Any raw stream snippet or proxies in front?
Alex (Sales): Browser console:
```
data: {"id":"m1","text":"Hello wor
```
then later:
```
data: ld\"}\n\n
```
Client: "Unexpected end of JSON input"
Jamie (Eng Runtime): Looks like chunk fragmentation. Check Cloudflare/nginx and HTTP/2 translation.
Ryan (SRE): Check LB/edge for RST/FIN. Also look for worker restarts.
Alex (Sales): They use Cloudflare + nginx. Access log shows 200 but client sees truncated chunks.
Jamie (Eng Runtime): Ask for curl --http1.1 -i -N output and tcpdump. We'll add heartbeat + flush on runtime canary.
Priya (SE): Send these repro steps: curl --http1.1 -N, force Accept: text/event-stream, try staging edge, disable CF minify.
Maria (Support): Request HAR, nginx config, and raw curl output. I'll draft the email.
Alex (Sales): They tried curl --http1.1; still flaky. Node eventsource shows same parse error.
Jamie (Eng Runtime): Recommend client-side buffer-until-valid-JSON as workaround. Also ensure server flushes after events.
Ryan (SRE): Nginx suggestions: proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 300s; sendfile off; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive".
Priya (SE): Action items:
- Maria: collect HAR + curl + nginx conf
- Ryan: check LB/limiter logs 14:10-14:15
- Jamie: deploy canary with heartbeat/flush
- Alex: schedule call with customer
infra-bot: Deployment succeeded: runtime/streaming-canary v2.14.3 -> us-east-2 at 2026-03-21T14:20:40Z
Alex (Sales): Thanks team. Will update after the call.
